IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.ContactChangeLogTbl', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.ContactChangeLogTbl ( ChangeLogID BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL CONSTRAINT PK_ContactChangeLogTbl PRIMARY KEY, ContactID INT NOT NULL, ChangedAt DATETIME NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_ContactChangeLog_ChangedAt DEFAULT (GETDATE()), ChangedBy NVARCHAR(128) NULL, Source NVARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, Summary NVARCHAR(500) NULL, FieldName NVARCHAR(64) NULL, OldValue NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL, NewValue NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL );
CREATE INDEX IX_ContactChangeLog_ContactChanged ON dbo.ContactChangeLogTbl (ContactID, ChangedAt DESC); END
